Inspection of the SSR blob shows ambulance='Not available' (honest scarcity — Minicoy has Government Hospital Minicoy but no published ambulance dispatch line) and local_police_station='Minicoy Police Station' (a station NAME, text-by-design like all local_police_station values). minicoy still publishes 6 dialable structured fields (police 100, fire 101, women 1091, tourist 04896-262258, road 1073, rescue_contact Deputy Collector 04892-222333 / 7042671197) — above the 3-field safety floor. Not a defect; consistent with honest-scarcity-over-fabrication. Other flagged local_police_station fields (badrinath, tso-moriri, fatehpur-sikri, marari, haflong) are all station names, text-by-design.
new_findings_today.recommendation: No action. Harness correctly counts these in structured-field totals but excludes them from dialable-phone counts. Optionally enrich minicoy ambulance with the Government Hospital Minicoy line if an official number can be verified.
